defects.description: The glossary term 'Объект обсуждения' (Subject) is incorrectly used to translate the English word 'subject' in the phrase 'not subject to a vote', where 'subject' is an adjective meaning 'dependent on' or 'under the control of', not the technical term for a discussion object.
